china-1925-6:p0079_1.rationale: Matrix of nautical-mile distances between ports on the European and Far Eastern sea routes. The subject is route distances between ports, which no existing tag covers precisely.
review_questions: Propose a tag for route or port-to-port distances; shipping and ports tags measure traffic or fleets, not distances.

china-1925-6:p0079_2.rationale: Distances from London and Europe to Chinese cities by the Siberian rail-sea route. This is a route-distance table, not traffic or railway operating data.
review_questions: Propose a tag for route distances. The Moscow/Mukden value is unreadable ([?]).

china-1925-6:p0079_3.rationale: Coastal distances in nautical miles between Shanghai and southern China ports. Only route distances are given, with no traffic or port measures.
review_questions: Propose a tag for route or port-to-port distances.

china-1925-6:p0079_4.rationale: Coastal distances in nautical miles between Shanghai and northern China ports. Only route distances are given.
review_questions: Propose a tag for route or port-to-port distances.

china-1925-6:p0080_1.rationale: River distances in miles between Yangtze ports from Shanghai to Chungking, for navigation reference. The table gives distances, not river physical description, navigation traffic or cargo.
review_questions: Propose a tag for route distances. One Shasi/Shanghai value is unreadable.

china-1925-6:p0080_2.rationale: Sea distances from Shanghai to northern and Japanese ports. Only route distances are given.
review_questions: Propose a tag for route distances.

china-1925-6:p0082_1.rationale: Main ranges of the Tienshan chain with their highest peaks and heights, which are physical landform characteristics.

china-1925-6:p0083_1.rationale: Elevations of the successive ranges of the Kuenlun chain, which are physical landform characteristics.

china-1925-6:p0083_2.rationale: Elevations of the southern mountain ranges, which are physical landform characteristics. Some values are blank in the source.

china-1925-6:p0097_1.rationale: Compares world rivers with the Yangtze by length, basin area and discharge, which are river system characteristics.
